name: trading-bot
description: 🤖 Automated Trading Bot with 4 strategies, AI validation, and real-time dashboard
author: elkun <negro.y.gti@gmail.com>

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.setup: npm install && cd backend && npm install && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx prisma migrate reset --force && npx prisma generate
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules backend/dist frontend/dist backend/.next
scripts.version: 2.0.0 — Post-optimizaciones (1h+4h, SL dinámico, trailing stop, filtro SMA200)
